compartment.title: Routing, Availability, Loop Controls, and Pollux

paths.notes: 82 lines; defines RoutingStrategy, TerminalStrategy, RoutingContext, RoutingDecision.

evidence.claim: Routing entry point is GeminiClient.getModelRouterService().route(routingContext); invoked exactly once per prompt unless stickiness is cleared (new prompt_id or CoreEvent.ModelChanged).
evidence.notes: Truth 1; confirmed with explicit tests for sticky / reset-on-new-prompt / reroute-on-ModelChanged.

evidence.claim: ModelRouterService composes a chain-of-responsibility: FallbackStrategy -> OverrideStrategy -> ApprovalModeStrategy -> [GemmaClassifierStrategy?] -> ClassifierStrategy -> NumericalClassifierStrategy -> DefaultStrategy (terminal).
evidence.notes: Truth 2; composition order is explicitly asserted by a unit test and by a separate gemma-toggle test.

evidence.claim: Routing can emit up to one extra LLM call (role UTILITY_ROUTER) against the 'classifier' alias, which resolves to gemini-2.5-flash-lite, per prompt reaching ClassifierStrategy or NumericalClassifierStrategy.
evidence.notes: Truth 3. Falsifies the 'zero extra API calls' claim in POLLUX_SPEC for baseline runs.

evidence.claim: On every turn, the sticky currentSequenceModel is re-resolved through applyModelSelection, so availability state can still mutate the final model id even when the router is not re-consulted.
ModelAvailabilityService exposes a per-session health map with three logical states (healthy / sticky_retry / terminal); resetTurn() is called from sendMessageStream at the top of each user prompt.

Two independent fallback paths exist: FallbackStrategy (inside the router, pre-call) and handleFallback (outside the router, from retryWithBackoff post-failure). Both resolve through policyCatalog + ModelAvailabilityService.
evidence.notes: Truth 6; handler.test.ts enumerates all FallbackIntent branches.

evidence.claim: LoopDetectionService is a two-tier system: heuristic (0 extra LLM calls) + LLM tier (0-2 calls, starts at turn 30, fires every llmCheckInterval in [5..15] turns).
Loop-detection double-check uses the alias 'loop-detection-double-check' which is bound to gemini-3-pro-preview; gated by ModelAvailabilityService.snapshot(...).available.
evidence.notes: Truth 8; 'should only call Flash model if main model is unavailable' test asserts the gate.

evidence.claim: The VALID_GEMINI_MODELS set contains eight identifiers (gemini-2.5-{pro,flash,flash-lite} + five preview variants across Gemini 3 and 3.1). Aliases auto/pro/flash/flash-lite/auto-gemini-3/auto-gemini-2.5 all resolve into one of those eight contextually.
The Pollux scaffold is a stub: packages/core/src/pollux/index.ts is 10 lines containing only a banner comment and `export {};`; the benchmark/ subdirectory is empty.
evidence.notes: Truth 10. Negative search rg 'pollux|Pollux|POLLUX' packages returned a single match (the banner itself). Get-ChildItem packages/core/src/pollux -Recurse returned 2 entries: index.ts + empty dir.

evidence.claim: docs/cli/model-routing.md documents only the availability-driven fallback and GEMINI_MODEL precedence; it does not mention ClassifierStrategy, NumericalClassifierStrategy, or ApprovalModeStrategy, which are active by default.

ModelRouterService.route silently falls back to config.getModel() on composite-strategy exception, without consulting availability; compensated only by the post-router applyModelSelection in processTurn.
evidence.notes: Truth 12. Test does not cover the DefaultStrategy-throws path; only covers generic exception logging + telemetry.

evidence.claim: Setting experimentalDynamicModelConfiguration=true rewires both the availability chain resolution (to modelChains) and the model-registry predicates (resolveModel, isGemini3Model, isAutoModel) to use modelDefinitions metadata.

contradictions.description: POLLUX_SPEC 'single-model baseline' is false. Router + loop detection both emit silent UTILITY LLM calls; Conditions A/E in the benchmark cannot be reproduced without pinning override + disabling LLM loop checks.

ModelRouterService exception fallback hardcodes config.getModel() without availability; safe today only because processTurn re-runs applyModelSelection. A future refactor removing that could allow a terminal-marked model to slip through.
docs/cli/model-routing.md incomplete: does not describe classifier, numerical classifier, or approval-mode strategies.
Pollux scaffold diverges from POLLUX_SPEC architecture diagram: no interceptor, advisor client, escalation detector, logger, or benchmark runner exists.

Spec's synthetic-tool advisor injection does not compose with the existing pre-turn routing decision (router is consulted per prompt, not per event). Spec is silent on which model the advisor call should use.

ClassifierStrategy and NumericalClassifierStrategy couple implicitly via inverse checks of getNumericalRoutingEnabled() + isGemini3Model(); breaking either check would cause double-routing or zero-routing.

DefaultStrategy (terminal) does not consult availability; relies on FallbackStrategy running earlier. CompositeStrategy swallows non-terminal exceptions, so a throw in FallbackStrategy can reach DefaultStrategy with no availability check.

risks.description: currentSequenceModel blocks re-routing during a prompt; mid-prompt availability changes are invisible to the router unless they flow through CoreEvent.ModelChanged.
risks.suggestedGuard: Document 'to reroute mid-prompt, emit CoreEvent.ModelChanged' as a runtime contract; add a test that marks a model terminal mid-turn and asserts no silent reroute.

risks.description: LLM loop-detection double-check can silently cost a full gemini-3-pro-preview call with 20 turns of history at turn 30+. Uncapped input size; corrupts benchmark Condition A.
risks.suggestedGuard: For benchmark builds: either cap queryLoopDetectionModel input tokens, or force config.getDisableLoopDetection() = true.

risks.description: CompositeStrategy swallows non-terminal exceptions and only debug-logs. No telemetry event is emitted per-strategy failure; production regressions are invisible unless debug logging is enabled.
risks.suggestedGuard: Emit a RoutingStrategyFailedEvent on per-strategy exception with strategy.name + error.

risks.description: handleFallback calls resolvePolicyChain(config) without passing failedModel as preferredModel; after an earlier fallback has updated the active model, subsequent chain resolution can lose models above the degraded position.
risks.suggestedGuard: Pass failedModel into resolvePolicyChain as preferredModel and add a multi-fallback integration test.

risks.description: ApprovalModeStrategy bakes wall-clock latency into reasoning text; makes benchmark replay diffs noisy.
risks.suggestedGuard: Strip latency fields from RoutingDecision.metadata.reasoning before logging in benchmark runs.

risks.description: Pollux scaffold directory (empty export barrel) silently succeeds imports; future contributors may assume runtime capability that does not exist.
risks.suggestedGuard: Either remove the scaffold until Phase 1 lands or export a POLLUX_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS='scaffold' constant for programmatic checks.

observabilitySignals: LlmRole.UTILITY_ROUTER + UTILITY_LOOP_DETECTOR tagging (telemetry/llmRole.ts:7-19) flowing through LoggingContentGenerator
CoreEvent.ModelChanged (emitted by config.activateFallbackMode; consumed by GeminiClient at client.ts:121)
gaps: CompositeStrategy non-terminal exception path not tested (R-07.3).
Router exception fallback when DefaultStrategy itself throws not tested (C-07.2).
Mid-prompt full fallback integration (handleFallback -> activateFallbackMode -> emitModelChanged -> reroute) not tested end-to-end.
Loop-detection LLM call token-budget not capped or tested (R-07.2).
Numerical routing threshold resolution (getResolvedClassifierThreshold) only indirectly covered.

openQuestions: OQ-07.1: With FallbackStrategy placed before OverrideStrategy, does an explicit user --model always win if the requested model is healthy? Short answer is yes (Fallback returns null when snapshot.available), but confirm there is no regression path.
OQ-07.2: When isGemini3Model is called with model='classifier' or with alias 'auto-gemini-3' vs 'auto-gemini-2.5', does it consistently gate the numerical strategy?
OQ-07.3: Does compositeStrategy.test.ts cover the per-strategy-exception path (non-terminal throws, terminal continues)? Not inspected in this pass.
OQ-07.4: When disableLoopDetection is flipped mid-session via disableForSession(), does processTurn still call addAndCheck per event (with early return) or does it short-circuit the call?
OQ-07.5: Does the 'classifier' model-config-key resolve differently under experimentalDynamicModelConfiguration=true? If so, router/loop-detector token accounting changes across the flag.
OQ-07.6: Is there a way to disable only the LLM loop-check tier (keep heuristic active) without disabling loop detection entirely? Today config.getDisableLoopDetection() is all-or-nothing.
